newsitem.title: USA: General Binding names financial officer.
newsitem.headline: General Binding names financial officer.

text.p: General Binding Corp said Monday it promoted William Chambers Jr, 43, to the position of vice president and chief financial officer.
Former Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Edward McNulty has resigned to pursue other interests, the company said in a news release.

While at General Binding, Chambers has been involved in negotiations for the acquisition of properties for new manufacturing facilities as well as the restructuring of certain of the company's operations.
General Binding designs, makes and distributes business machines used for binding, laminating and printing.
Shares of General Binding closed off 1/8 at 26-3/8.
